details.further_information: Henrick Do Marcolino is the son of Fabrice Do Marcolino (Youth Scout Stade Rennais FC).Henrick Do Marcolino is the nephew of Arsène Do Marcolino (Retired).Henrick Do Marcolino is the brother of Alan Do Marcolino (FK Viagem Usti nad Labem).Henrick Do Marcolino is the cousin of Jonathan Do Marcolino (Football Bourg-en-Bresse Péronnas 01).
